⚡ 1. Beginner Jargon Unpack
- **Constitutional Provision:** Direct text, article, or clause written in the Constitution of India.
- **Statutory Body:** Entity established by an Act of Parliament (e.g. NHRC, CVC, NITI Aayog), distinct from Constitutional Bodies established directly by an Article (e.g. ECI, CAG, UPSC).
- **Judicial Precedent:** Binding interpretation of law established by Supreme Court rulings under Article 141.
